authority.service: reads the authoritative User row, freezes current status/is_active/role/raw tenant and the effective personal tenant, then conditionally claims that exact material in the decision transaction
authority.scope: global/system community registry; audit attributed to the acting reviewer's current tenant/user

routes.effect: guarded UPDATE status Untrusted -> Active plus one AuditLog receipt
routes.transitions: Untrusted -> Active; already Active new operation -> no_change/effect=none; same-operation replay -> already_applied; unsupported -> 409

routes.effect: guarded community-row DELETE plus one AuditLog tombstone
routes.transitions: missing -> 404; same-operation tombstone -> already_applied; stale/competing -> 409 peer preserved

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id skill:<promote|delete>:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw skill body, generated code, package list, scan payload, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target state/material digest must match

result_states.no_change: already-Active promote with a new operation id; 200 effect=none; no audit
result_states.effect_unknown: 503 effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception text

parallel_writers.routes: sole verified writers for community skill status/delete
parallel_writers.SkillRegistryService: promote_skill/delete_skill retained for internal/test callers; routes no longer use them
